searchQueryDaily.title: Search Query Daily
searchQueryDaily.summary: One search query on one page on one day, as Search Console reports it.
searchQueryDaily.description: Imported by SearchConsoleImportService from the Search Console API (searchanalytics/query, dimensions date, query, page) and upserted per (property, date, query, page), so a re-run of the same window changes nothing. Read by the Search queries page through SearchQueryReportService. Contains counts only, never a visitor. Part of the fleet traffic analytics programme, phase 2 (marketing-campaign-attribution).

property.title: Property
property.description: The Search Console property: a site URL such as https://example.org/ or a domain property such as sc-domain:example.org.

date.title: Date
date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD, as Search Console reports it (Pacific time).

page.title: Page
page.description: The page URL that appeared in the results.

clicks.title: Clicks
clicks.description: Clicks from the results to the page for this query on this day.

impressions.title: Impressions
impressions.description: How often the page appeared in the results for this query on this day.

ctr.title: CTR
ctr.description: Clicks divided by impressions, between 0 and 1.

position.title: Position
position.description: The average position in the results, 1 being the top.

source.title: Source
source.description: Which search engine reported the row. Only gsc today.

importedAt.title: Imported at
importedAt.description: When the importer last wrote this row.
